706940101.text: Miss Bold Bang, is your lower back still hurting?

706940102.text: I'm good now... That hot compress worked like a charm!

706940103.text: Heh, to make a hot compress like this, you have to heat the wet bandage with slow-burning gunpowder for just the right amount of time, or you might end up setting it on fire.

706940104.text: Only Yoimiya would come up with a way to warm up bandages like that!

706940105.text: #Hold on a second... Look who's here! Our hero both in name and deed, and {M#his}{F#her} little white companion!

706940106.text: Is this the part where a woven scroll comic scene unfolds right in front of me...?

706940109.text: Oh, please don't worry about me! I was just wandering about in the wild, looking for some new tough opponents to practice against.

706940110.text: Miss Yoimiya here was really a great help to me when I accidentally hurt my back and tumbled down the hill like a snowball!

706940112.text: Heh, to quote The Soulblazer Saga, "I'm merely a warrior who happened to pass by"...

706940113.text: And now, we can make that a "free mercenary"! The Knights have granted me permission to take action and deal with monsters as I see fit.
